title: ガソリン高騰がGW直撃、夏休みにも影響か　遠出控える「安・近・短」志向くっきり
extracted_text: イラン情勢の緊迫化に伴う原油高や物価高がゴールデンウイーク（GW）を直撃している。出費を抑え、近場で短期間楽しむ「安・近・短」の志向が強まり、そうした需要を獲得しようとホテルや百貨店は対応を強化。一方、連休後に本格化する夏休みのツアーや航空券の販売にも影響が広がる恐れもあり、先行きへの懸念が強まっている。 3日、白い砂浜で知られる和歌山県白浜町の白良浜が海開きした。南紀白浜観光協会によると本州で最も早い海開き。この日は曇り空だったが、海水浴客らは安全を祈る神事の後、テープカットを合図に一斉に海へ駆け込み初泳ぎを楽しんだ。 一方、関係者は危機感を募らせている。白浜町のホテル・旅館でつくる白浜温泉旅館協同組合の沼田久博理事長は「遠方からや長期滞在の利用客が減っている。日帰りできる近場の観光にシフトしているのでは」。組合によると、地元レジャー施設のパンダが中国に返還されたことや、中国の訪日渡航自粛などもあり、1～3月の宿泊者数は前年同月比1割減で推移している。 白浜町は、県内外から自家用車で訪れる観光客が多い。沼田氏は客足が鈍い要因について、原油高によるガソリン代の高騰も影響していると推測する。 調査会社インテージによるGWの過ごし方についてのアンケートでは、「予定なし」が前年から4・7ポイント増の41・2％となり、「自宅で過ごす」が35・1％、「外食に行く」が17・0％で続いた（複数回答）。 「リーガロイヤルホテル大阪　ヴィニェット　コレクション」（大阪市）は、館内8つのレストランでGW期間中、小学生以下の子供を無料にするなどの特典を用意。広報担当者は「遠方への旅行の代わりに、近場で家族そろっての食事を楽しむ需要が増えるのでは」との見方を示す。 あべのハルカス近鉄本店（同市）は1日から、東京や沖縄など10店舗の人気かき氷店や、水生生物に触れる水族館などのイベントを開催している。同店の担当者は、節約志向が高まっても娯楽や特別な日にはお金を惜しみなく使う「メリハリ消費」は定着していると指摘。その上で、「夏や秋に向けても体験型のイベントに力を入れ、地元客の来店頻度を高めたい」と語る。 原油価格が不安定な状況や、物価高は当面続くとの見方が強い。航空・旅行アナリストの鳥海高太朗氏は「ガソリン高や航空運賃の値上がりなども続きそうだ。夏の旅行に与える影響は格段に大きくなるため、旅行の予定は可能な限り早めに立てるべきだ」と述べた。（田村慶子、前川康二）
translated_text: The surge in crude oil prices and inflation driven by the escalating situation in Iran is hitting Golden Week (GW) head-on. There's a growing preference for "cheap, nearby, short" activities to save money and enjoy short trips close to home, and hotels and department stores are strengthening their offerings to capture this demand. However, there's concern that this could also spread to tours and flight ticket sales for summer vacations, which ramp up after the holiday period, raising further worries about the outlook. On the 3rd, Shirarahama Beach in the town of Shirahama, Wakayama Prefecture, known for its white sandy shores, opened for the swimming season. According to the Nanki Shirahama Tourism Association, this is the earliest beach opening on Honshu. Though the sky was cloudy that day, after a shrine ritual praying for safety, beachgoers cut the ribbon and rushed into the sea together for their first swim. Meanwhile, those involved are growing more apprehensive. Chairman Numata Hisahiro of the Shirahama Hot Spring Ryokan Cooperative, an association of hotels and ryokan in Shirahama, said, "We're seeing fewer visitors coming from far away or staying for extended periods. They seem to be shifting to nearby tourism that can be done as a day trip." According to the association, the number of overnight guests from January to March decreased by 10% compared to the same period the previous year, due in part to the return of pandas to local leisure facilities in China and Chinese travel restrictions to Japan. Shirahama town receives many tourists who come by car from within and outside the prefecture. Numata suspects that rising gasoline prices due to crude oil costs are also contributing to the slowdown in visitors. In a survey by research company Intage about how people would spend Golden Week, the percentage of those with "no plans" increased by 4.7 points from the previous year to 41.2%, while "spending time at home" accounted for 35.1% and "eating out" 17.0% (multiple responses). Osaka's Rihga Royal Hotel Vinheta Collection is offering special promotions during Golden Week, including free meals for children at all eight restaurants. A public relations representative commented, "We expect demand to increase for family dining experiences nearby, as an alternative to traveling far away." From the 1st, Abeno Harukas Kintetsu Main Branch in Osaka is hosting events featuring popular shaved ice shops from Tokyo and Okinawa, as well as aquariums where visitors can interact with aquatic creatures. A store representative noted that even with the rising trend toward saving money, consumers have become accustomed to "balanced spending" - splurging on entertainment and special occasions. They added, "We plan to focus on experience-based events heading into summer and autumn to increase the frequency of local customers visiting our store." Many believe crude oil price instability and inflation will continue for the time being. Aviation and travel analyst Takahashi Toriumi said, "Gasoline prices and airfare increases are likely to continue. The impact on summer travel will be significantly greater, so travel plans should be made as early as possible." (Keiko Tamura, Koji Maekawa)
title_en: Gasoline Price Hikes Hit Golden Week Hard, May Also Affect Summer Vacation - Clear Trend Toward 'Cheap, Nearby, Short' Trips
